title: Replit pricing: billing basis and cost boundaries
summary: Replit pricing: billing basis and cost boundaries. Separate the recorded base price from unverified usage and operating costs.

sections.heading: Prototype budget
paragraphs: Replit's current public sources list Core at USD 20/month and USD 18/month equivalent on annual billing. Record the applicable cadence, account terms, location-dependent taxes and checkout total; those base prices do not establish a full application budget.

sections.heading: Live service budget
paragraphs: Obtain the runtime, storage, data transfer and agent-use basis separately. Confirm spending controls and how failures affect billing before approving a production operating budget.

sections.heading: No task-to-credit exchange rate
paragraphs: A request, a credit and a token are not interchangeable. ToolPilot has not measured a representative workload across these products, so this guide does not invent a shared usage conversion or promise a fixed number of completed tasks.

verdict: The current public sources list Core monthly and annual-billed base prices; use a cost checklist until account, region and workload-specific costs are confirmed.
bestFor: Buyers checking Replit subscription and usage assumptions
notFor: Readers seeking a guaranteed workload total without measuring usage
migration: Trial the candidate on a branch; retain the original workflow until tests, export and billing checks pass.
gaps: Confirm account eligibility and location-based checkout taxes and total; the published base prices do not establish included usage or the full application operating budget.

pros.text: Replit’s plan page exposes monthly and yearly billing choices and states that tax depends on location, so a quote should record cadence and region.
The same page warns that Agent is probabilistic and may make mistakes, supporting a review and validation budget alongside the plan quote.

cons.text: The public pricing sources list Core base prices, but this draft does not confirm account-specific checkout, total taxes or a representative application's included and additional usage.
A plan selection does not by itself establish the operating cost or recovery path for a deployed application; price runtime needs and validate checkpoints separately.

faqs.question: What Replit Core billing bases are publicly listed?
faqs.answer: Replit lists USD 20/month with monthly billing and USD 18/month equivalent billed annually. Taxes depend on location; confirm account checkout and budget runtime, database and agent usage separately.

faqs.question: Does the plan price guarantee an application’s full operating budget?
faqs.answer: No. This draft has not established runtime costs or an independent recovery route. Confirm the plan allowance, app usage and backup/export needs before committing.
